text: In a follow-up survey completed by 91 of 102 qualifying workers, those who reported reading the snippets had significantly higher accuracy in PS and PSA than those who did not, but there were no significant differences in PSA accuracy between workers who reported reading versus ignoring the arguments. A quarter of workers reported mistrusting the arguments, though mistrust did not correlate with performance.
title: Survey: snippet readers more accurate, argument readers not; a quarter mistrust arguments
